dedupe_keys.name: uganda road data for travel time maps

description: Uganda Road Data for Travel Time Maps is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Data for Children Collaborative with UNICEF and University of Edinburgh. School of Geosciences. This.shp file is a polyline shapefile containing the roads data in Uganda that was used to create the Uganda cost allocation/friction surfaces. The data are a combination (merged) of Open Street Map roads data and MapwithAi project roads data. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Data for Children Collaborative with UNICEF and University of Edinburgh. School of Geosciences. Its tags are least-cost-path, children travel time, travel time, health access, health utilization. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
